item.description:
0.35.0

New

  • Storage shows what your devboxes take on disk

0.34.0

New

  • A devbox can be given a time to live
  • A devbox's page shows how to reach it over SSH
  • Choose which repository new devboxes are made from
  • This Mac shows the VM a devbox holds

Fixed

  • Setup says a Mac can serve several repositories

0.33.0

New

  • A devbox greets you over SSH too
  • A devbox is called inside what you called it

Fixed

  • This Mac's page stays put while the daemon restarts

0.32.1

Fixed

  • After an update the daemon is restarted without a button flashing by
  • Ssh into a devbox connects

0.32.0

New

  • Ssh into a devbox, through the Mac and never over the network
  • The update window says what is new
